test_case_name: Accept Cookies on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the parent page to accept all cookies.
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the child page to accept cookies.
And then check that both cookie banners are dismissed and cookies are accepted on both pages.

test_case_name: Open Sustainability Section from Parent and Accept Cookies

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the child page to accept cookies.
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and the sustainability news are visible on the child page.

test_case_name: Search for Information on Both Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search field on the parent page.
Click the 'Cerca (desktop)' button on the parent page to submit the search.
Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click the 'Open search' button on the child page to open the search field.
Type $name in the 'Cerca' search field on the child page.
Click the 'Submit search' button on the child page to submit the search.
And then check that relevant search results are displayed on both pages.

test_case_name: Navigate to Sustainability Policy from Parent to Child

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Policy di sostenibilità' in the aside menu on the child page.
And then check that the sustainability policy page is displayed on the child site.

test_case_name: Switch Language to English on Child Page After Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'EN' in the language selector on the child page.
And then check that the child page is displayed in English.

test_case_name: Access User Area and Logout on Child Page After Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'AREA UTENTE' button on the child page to open the user area dropdown.
Click 'Logout' button on the child page to log out.
And then check that the user is logged out and redirected appropriately on the child page.

test_case_name: Open Main Menu on Child Page After Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click the 'Open main menu' button on the child page.
And then check that the main menu is displayed on the child page.

test_case_name: Navigate to Sustainability News from Parent to Child

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Scopri tutte le news di sostenibilità' on the child page.
And then check that the sustainability news section is displayed on the child page.

test_case_name: Access Sustainability Reporting from Parent to Child

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Reporting di sostenibilità' in the aside menu on the child page.
And then check that the sustainability reporting page is displayed on the child site.

test_case_name: Open and Cancel Search on Child Page After Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'News' on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click the 'Open search' button on the child page to open the search field.
Click the 'Cancel search' button on the child page to close the search field.
And then check that the search field is closed on the child page.
